It excels at defending against even the most brutal of attacks and cutting down powerful foes when deflecting.|Inventory|TotK}} Savage Lynel Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 62 |durability = 20 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Savage Lynel Shield}} Savage Lynel Shields are considered the ultimate [[Lynel Shield]], known to be wielded by [[White-Maned Lynel]]s. They are also used by [[Silver Lynel]]s and [[Golden Lynel]]s. Not only are they capable of defending the most brutal of attacks, they can also cut down powerful foes with a deflection (dealing 21 damage). They belong to the [[Lynel Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all [[Weapon]]s created by [[Lynel]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} As they are made of metal, Savage Lynel Shields will attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a thunderstorm. They also sink if they are dropped in water, but they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Finally, they will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_018" |Life = 20 |GuardPower = 62 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 11 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 12 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 12 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 22 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Savage Lynel Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} Savage Lynel Shields reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Savage Lynel Shields can be wielded by [[Link]] in conjunction with [[Savage Lynel Sword]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Lynel Gear * Lynel Shield * Mighty Lynel Shield * Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Lynel Gear, Shields |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
